Get the interface. Tessellate turns product intent into cohesive interface systems using an open library of components, patterns, motion and design intelligence. PRESET EXEMPLARS: AI research terminal luxury travel marketplace playful HR platform developer observability tool minimalist finance app PRODUCT BRIEF Deterministic Core Active FEEL AMBITION 60 / 100 STRUCTURE 50 / 100 STACK React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 Compose CURRENT SETTINGS Visual ambition 60 / 100 Structural creativity 50 / 100 These are your selected values. Compose carries them with the brief into the deterministic product pipeline. THREE DIRECTIONS, ONE PRODUCT Choose a direction. Or blend them. Generate an employee experience example with the real catalogue and composer. Compare its sidebar, editorial and rail workspace structures, then edit the exact project in Workbench. Generate example directionsCompose your own brief THE COMPOSITION PARADIGM Not a component library. A composition system. A resource catalogue gives you reusable building blocks. Tessellate adds a product brief, shared design settings, and a manifest that connects screens, resources, and project intent. Starting from a Resource Catalogue Choose resources: The product team decides which components belong on each screen. Carry design decisions: Shared tokens and interaction patterns need to stay aligned across resources. Connect the screens: The team defines navigation, content, and how interface parts work together. Review generated code: Check markup, styles, and behavior in the context of the product. Outcome: Resource choice, integration, and consistency remain with the product team. Tessellate Composition Engine Product model: Interprets a brief into a product domain, audience, and user jobs before planning screens. Design DNA: Shared visual settings guide composition and apply to resources that support them. Manifest audit: A 100-point rubric scores declared structure and resource metadata; it does not certify the rendered interface. Validated mutations: Workbench and integration tools apply typed manifest changes while respecting locked scope. Outcome: Export a standalone React + Tailwind project from the manifest you composed and reviewed. THE RESOURCE VOCABULARY Open resources. Clear sample data.
